title: Target profile
description: The whole-document shape of a target profile, `spec/targets/<target_id>.yaml`: the operator-authored description of what one run builds for — one value per target axis (hardware class, toolchain, parallel model, execution shape) and the harness a node built for that target runs over. Read by `tools/run_workflow.py --target` at launch, before anything runs; no leaf chooses or edits it. Every axis value is an opaque lowercase token that the host asks the backend registry about and never interprets itself. This schema is a DECLARATIVE COPY: the loader holds the same key sets as constants (`PROFILE_SHAPE`) and enforces them without this file, and `tools/tests/test_target_profile.py` pins the two copies together. The rules draft-07 cannot carry live in the loader: `target_id` must equal the file stem, the harness must resolve to an `infrastructure` spec in `spec/registry/spec_catalog.yaml`, and each axis value must be one this repository implements.

target_id.description: The profile's id; must equal the file stem.

compiler.description: Optional pin of the build compiler (the `compiler` axis).

x-forbidden-examples.why: unknown key: the toolchain is closed

x-forbidden-examples-note: The schema rejects all three on its own. The loader additionally rejects a `target_id` that is not the file stem and a harness the catalog does not resolve.
